$comment: Sample specification payload for two-site web scraping with WebScrapingAgent
prompt: Scrape competitor pricing from two vendor sites, normalize to our catalog schema, and forward the merged payload to our internal ingestion webhook.
expected_ba_invariants: Both sites sell the same underlying SKU with different naming conventions
Prices must be parsed as floating point numbers and normalized to USD
Availability must be mapped to a boolean 'in_stock' field
The destination endpoint expects: { normalized_sku, lowest_price, sources: [{ vendor, price, in_stock }] }
